_meta.title: Liberia — under-5 mortality (deaths per 1,000 live births)
_meta.source: UN Inter-agency Group for Child Mortality Estimation (UN IGME) — SH.DYN.MORT
_meta.note: The trajectory is real progress — from 263 deaths per 1,000 births in 1990 to 71 in 2023 — but the level is still nearly double the Sub-Saharan African average (38).
